# Educated

By Westover.

I read it on the train over two weeks, a chapter a day. I would give it four stars out of five. Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning.

Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later. Not as good as the previous book by the same author. The audiobook narrator is excellent.

The middle part drags, the last third makes up for it.
